deck_title: Chorin-Helmholtz pressure-Poisson divergence projection vs naive compressive inflow pileup rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Alexandre Chorin (Math. Comp. 1968) & Helmholtz-Hodge orthogonal pressure-Poisson divergence projection (solving laplacian(p) = div(u_raw) and subtracting grad(p) so div(u_sol) = 0.0000 while preserving vorticity curl(u_sol) === curl(u_raw), locking incompressible mass-density ratio rho(t+dt)/rho0 = 1.0000x across all 17 compressive inflow stations -dt*div(u_raw) = 2u in [0.0000, 2.0000] with 0/17 compressed stations) versus naive unprojected velocity advection (which leaves -dt*div(u_raw) = 2u active, piling up smoke/fluid density as 1 + 2u to 1.5000x at u=0.25, 2.0000x at u=0.50, and 3.0000x at u=1.00 across 16/17 stations) and 64-iteration Jacobi Poisson relaxation.
